notes.title: Monster Ops 7 Now Live on Steam!
notes.content:
You can play Monster Ops Episode 1 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3004790/Monster_Ops/?snr=1_5_9_]free here[/url], [b]get episodes 2-6 in a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/53558/Monster_Ops_Episodes_16/]bundle here[/url][/b], and now [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3264370/Monster_Ops_7/]Episode 7 is live[/url]!  [b](The next bundle will be episodes 7-12 in November 2025)[/b].

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3264370/Monster_Ops_7/][img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/35059450/8cbd94a75b40da07e29db9f5a35eb76fd34a6330.png[/img][/url]

Tide is a prisoner of a Bolivian drug cartel run by two monsters!  Fortunately he's able to use the serum to make one like him.  The other is out to kill him!

Can Wraith and Ambrosilas rescue Tide in time?  Can they achieve their mission to kill the monsters Erebus and Ramon?  And what will Wraith do when a monster serum triggers him.  The only one around for relief is...Ambrosilas?!

The action and sex-packed conclusion of the two-part mid-season finale!

[h1][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3264370/Monster_Ops_7/]Grab Episode 7 Now![/url][/h1]

And remember, beta Patrons are on episode 12 this month!  Join our [url=https://discord.gg/KyhMvJg]Discord[/url] or visit our [url=https://ypressgames.com/]web site[/url] to learn how to get episodes 6 months early!
